proposal.goal: Graduate Jichi Insight as a nationwide municipality insight platform. Continue autonomously from Phase 15 through complete canonical coverage, public-product alignment, and final runtime verification; preserve fiscal/document/version distinctions and evidence boundaries. Continue autonomously from the current repository state and do not stop at an intermediate milestone while safe executable work remains. Graduation criteria: [1] Canonical coverage includes every intended municipality; each is validly evidenced or explicitly unresolved, never omitted. [2] Evidence retains official URLs, stable locators, plan/version/period/fiscal/availability boundaries, provenance and deferred depth; no invented facts, causality, comparisons, rankings or scores. [3] Candidate generation, validation, review staging, promotion and public-data pipelines are deterministic, resumable and free of machine-resolvable blockers; required human review gates remain explicit. [4] Public browse/search/detail uses current canonical nationwide data and passes repository plus production smoke checks. [5] CI, regression, data-quality and final runtime verification are green; queue exhaustion or campaign completion alone never means project completion. Only the verified completion marker does. Keep CI, validation, provenance, quota limits, and existing human-only safety boundaries intact. Only when every graduation criterion is demonstrably satisfied and final repository/runtime checks are green, create or update docs/ADE_COMPLETION.json as JSON with schema_version=1 and status=COMPLETE plus concise evidence fields. If the marker does not yet qualify, choose the highest-value bounded next work. For every path that does not yet exist in the repository snapshot, explicitly phrase the plan step as 'Create new file <exact-path>' and declare that exact path in new_paths; never treat a missing path as an existing file.
